description: This source file implements functions for managing UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) sections and options, including creation, deletion, lookup, and committing changes, within the beerocks::bpl namespace.

methods.name: uci_get_error
methods.description: Retrieves the error string from a uci_context.

methods.name: alloc_context
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a shared pointer to a uci_context with proper cleanup.

methods.name: uci_section_exists
methods.description: Checks if a section with specified package name, type, and name exists in UCI.

methods.name: uci_find_section_by_option
methods.description: Finds a section by package, type, and option key/value pair, returning the section name.

methods.name: uci_add_section
methods.description: Adds a new section of specified type and name to a package, optionally committing changes.

methods.name: uci_set_section
methods.description: Sets options for a specified section, creating or updating options, with optional commit.

methods.name: uci_get_section
methods.description: Retrieves all options within a specified section.

methods.name: uci_get_section_type
methods.description: Retrieves the type of a specified section.

methods.name: uci_get_option
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific option within a section.

methods.name: uci_delete_section
methods.description: Deletes a specified section from a package, with optional commit.

methods.name: uci_get_all_sections
methods.description: Retrieves all section names of a specified type within a package.

methods.name: uci_commit_changes
methods.description: Commits all pending changes to the specified package.
